# dacode-dm-csv-032

## Instruction
Calculate the proportion of 1-day retention being True for the gate_30 and gate_40 versions.

## About Dataset
Cookie Cats is a hugely popular mobile puzzle game developed by Tactile Entertainment. It's a classic "connect three" style puzzle game where players connect tiles of the same color to clear the board and win levels. As players progress, they encounter gates that force them to wait before progressing or making in-app purchases. This project analyzes the result of an A/B-test where the first gate in Cookie Cats was moved from level 30 to level 40. The dataset contains user retention data for both versions.
